invariants.rationale: The returned map should never be null as it is explicitly instantiated before being returned.
Method assumes dedupedRecords is non-null as it streams and maps over it without null checks.
Partitioner is used without null checks, and its methods are invoked.
All returned HoodieRecords are subsets of the input dedupedRecords.
Every dedupedRecord is distributed among (possibly multiple) partition map entries, preserving the total count.
